comments.author: H.-Gazi
comments.body:
This ship hasn't been released in GAMA server yet (in bottle). It is not certain if this will be added in-game, because I my feeling tells that this is ship is really overpowerd.

With good improvements and buff addition, this ship is strong in cannon AND melee battle. This ship can have over the 370 sailors and durability is near 1.500 (with improvements). It makes in melee battle even deadlier than MLA / ALA ships and in terms of speed is this also superior.

I think IF this ship is released in GAMA, the price will be sure the same as IATS (50b+) in ticket depending on the rarity also.
